from pathlib import Path
from collections import Counter
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import hashlib, json, math, platform, socket, sys
from importlib.metadata import version
from IPython.display import display, Markdown
import ngsolve as ng
from ngsolve.webgui import Draw
from cubit_mesh_export.check import check_consistency

HERE = next(p for p in [Path.cwd(), Path.cwd() / 'docs/cubit_mesh_export']
            if (p / 'hex_sphere_highorder/hexsph_o1.vol').exists())
ng.SetNumThreads(2)
meshes, mesh_records = {}, []
for order in (1, 2, 3):
    path = HERE / 'hex_sphere_highorder' / f'hexsph_o{order}.vol'
    report = check_consistency(str(path))
    assert report['passed'], report
    mesh = ng.Mesh(str(path))
    meshes[order] = mesh
    counts = dict(Counter(str(e.type) for e in mesh.Elements(ng.VOL)))
    with ng.TaskManager():
        volume = ng.Integrate(ng.CF(1), mesh, order=10)
    mesh_records.append(dict(order=order, mesh_path=path.relative_to(HERE).as_posix(),
        sha256=hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), elements=counts,
        materials=list(mesh.GetMaterials()), boundaries=list(mesh.GetBoundaries()),
        volume=volume, volume_error_percent=100*(volume/(4*math.pi*0.05**3/3)-1),
        check_vol=report))
    print('Geometry order:', order, 'elements:', counts, 'volume:', volume)
    print('Materials:', mesh.GetMaterials(), 'boundaries:', mesh.GetBoundaries())
    print('check-vol:', report['passed'], 'CAD reference:', report['cad_reference']['available'])

mesh = meshes[1]
scene = Draw(mesh, name="Cubit_HEX_geometry_order_1", order=3,
     draw_vol=True, draw_surf=True, width="100%", height="480px",
     settings={"Objects": {"Edges": True, "Wireframe": True}})
scene.GenerateHTML(filename=str(HERE / 'hex_order_1.html'))

mesh = meshes[2]
scene = Draw(mesh, name="Cubit_HEX_geometry_order_2", order=3,
     draw_vol=True, draw_surf=True, width="100%", height="480px",
     settings={"Objects": {"Edges": True, "Wireframe": True}})
scene.GenerateHTML(filename=str(HERE / 'hex_order_2.html'))

mesh = meshes[3]
scene = Draw(mesh, name="Cubit_HEX_geometry_order_3", order=3,
     draw_vol=True, draw_surf=True, width="100%", height="480px",
     settings={"Objects": {"Edges": True, "Wireframe": True}})
scene.GenerateHTML(filename=str(HERE / 'hex_order_3.html'))

mesh = meshes[3]
with ng.TaskManager():
    exact = ng.sin(8*ng.x)*ng.cos(6*ng.y)
    fes = ng.H1(mesh, order=3, dirichlet=".*")
    solution = ng.GridFunction(fes)
    solution.Set(exact, ng.BND)
    u, v = fes.TnT()
    a = ng.BilinearForm(ng.grad(u)*ng.grad(v)*ng.dx).Assemble()
    rhs = ng.LinearForm(100*exact*v*ng.dx).Assemble()
    residual = rhs.vec - a.mat*solution.vec
    solution.vec.data += a.mat.Inverse(fes.FreeDofs())*residual
    l2_error = math.sqrt(ng.Integrate((solution-exact)**2, mesh, order=10))
assert math.isfinite(l2_error)
print('H1 DOFs:', fes.ndof, 'L2 error:', l2_error)
scene = Draw(solution, mesh, name="Manufactured_Poisson_solution", order=3,
     draw_vol=True, draw_surf=True, autoscale=True,
     clipping={"x": 0, "y": 0, "z": 1, "dist": 0},
     vectors=False, width="100%", height="480px")

scene.GenerateHTML(filename=str(HERE / 'poisson_field.html'))

evidence = dict(schema="radia.cubit_mesh_webgui.v1",
    generated_at_utc=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    host=socket.gethostname(), python_executable=sys.executable,
    versions={p: version(p) for p in ['ngsolve', 'netgen-mesher', 'cubit-mesh-export', 'webgui-jupyter-widgets', 'anywidget']},
    python_version=platform.python_version(), threads=2,
    scope="Reload historical Cubit exports; check-vol, integrate and solve on mdx; no fresh Cubit export",
    meshes=mesh_records, poisson=dict(geometry_order=3, fe_order=3, ndof=fes.ndof, l2_error=l2_error))
(HERE / 'cubit_mesh_webgui_results.json').write_text(json.dumps(evidence, indent=2), encoding='utf-8')

from pathlib import Path
import json
from IPython.display import Markdown, display

candidates = [
    Path('cubit_mesh_export_showcase_results.json'),
    Path('docs/cubit_mesh_export/cubit_mesh_export_showcase_results.json'),
]
result_path = next((p for p in candidates if p.exists()), None)
assert result_path is not None, candidates
data = json.loads(result_path.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
summary = data['summary']
print('result_json:', result_path)
for key in ['validation_script_count', 'validation_summary_count', 'python_script_count', 'asset_count']:
    print(f'{key}: {summary[key]}')
print('high_order_hex_max_abs_error_percent:', summary['hex_high_order_max_abs_error_percent'])
print('poisson_error_drop_order1_to_3:', summary['hex_poisson_error_drop_ratio_order1_to_3'])
assert summary['validation_script_count'] == 18
assert summary['validation_summary_count'] == 18
assert summary['all_validation_summaries_present'] is True

volume_rows = data['hex_highorder']['volume_rows']
poisson_rows = data['hex_highorder']['poisson_rows']

header = '| Order | HEX count | Sphere volume error | Poisson ndof | Poisson L2 error |\n|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|'
body = []
for v, p in zip(volume_rows, poisson_rows):
    body.append(
        f"| {v['order']} | {p['hex']} | {v['error_percent']:+.3f}% | {p['ndof']} | {p['l2_error']:.3e} |"
    )
display(Markdown('\n'.join([header] + body)))

print(data['hex_highorder']['volume_stdout'])
print(data['hex_highorder']['poisson_stdout'])
assert max(abs(r['error_percent']) for r in volume_rows if r['order'] >= 2) < 1.0
assert poisson_rows[2]['l2_error'] < poisson_rows[1]['l2_error'] < poisson_rows[0]['l2_error']
